tagline.zh: 以小尺寸图像或字符代表人:圆/方两形,组内以负 margin 重叠、溢出折叠为 +N——尺寸与重叠宽度都是 token 化的,不是随手写死的。
tagline.en: A small image or glyph standing in for a person: circle or square, overlapping in a group via negative margins with the overflow folded into +N — size and overlap are tokenized, not eyeballed.

origin.zh: 规格对齐 Ant Design Avatar / Avatar.Group(antd 6.7.1):shape 默认 circle(index.zh-CN.md:44)、size 默认 medium 且像素基准 containerSize = controlHeight = 32(avatar/style/index.ts:209);组重叠宽度 groupOverlapping = -marginXS = -8px、组描边 groupBorderColor = colorBorderBg(白)(style/index.ts:219-221);Group 溢出折叠 max = { count, style, popover } 自 5.18.0(index.zh-CN.md:58)。
origin.en: Spec aligned with Ant Design Avatar / Avatar.Group (antd 6.7.1): shape defaults to circle (index.zh-CN.md:44); size defaults to medium with the pixel base containerSize = controlHeight = 32 (avatar/style/index.ts:209); group overlap groupOverlapping = -marginXS = -8px and group border groupBorderColor = colorBorderBg (white) (style/index.ts:219-221); group overflow folding max = { count, style, popover } since 5.18.0 (index.zh-CN.md:58).

effect.zh: CSS 变量型参数(--av-size 驱动宽高与字符字号)。默认 32px 对齐 antd:Avatar size 默认 medium,像素基准 containerSize = controlHeight = 32(style/index.ts:209 + seed controlHeight 32,06-antdesign.md §2.2);字符字号随尺寸按 14/32 ≈ 0.4375 比例缩放(antd textFontSize 默认 fontSize = 14,style/index.ts:212)。
effect.en: CSS-variable param (--av-size drives width/height and the glyph font size). The 32px default matches antd: Avatar size defaults to medium with pixel base containerSize = controlHeight = 32 (style/index.ts:209 + seed controlHeight 32, 06-antdesign.md §2.2); the glyph scales with size at the 14/32 ≈ 0.4375 ratio (antd textFontSize defaults to fontSize = 14, style/index.ts:212).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切换 data-shape)。antd shape 默认 circle(index.zh-CN.md:44);circle 圆角 50%,square 圆角取 antd seed borderRadius = 6(avatar/style/index.ts:98-100、118:非圆形头像用 token borderRadius 族,与尺寸无关)。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes and toggles data-shape). antd shape defaults to circle (index.zh-CN.md:44); circle uses a 50% radius while square uses antd's seed borderRadius = 6 (avatar/style/index.ts:98-100, 118: non-circle avatars take the token borderRadius family regardless of size).

effect.zh: JS 型参数:8 人内存名单中前 N 位实像展示,其余折叠为一个 +N 徽标。默认 4 为演示值(antd Avatar.Group max.count 无官方默认);对应 antd Group max = { count } 折叠语义(5.18.0+,index.zh-CN.md:58)。组内重叠固定 -8px(antd groupOverlapping = -marginXS,style/index.ts:220),不随 size 缩放。
effect.en: JS-type param: the first N members of an 8-person in-memory roster are shown, the rest fold into one +N chip. The default of 4 is a demo value (antd Avatar.Group max.count has no documented default); it mirrors antd Group max = { count } folding semantics (5.18.0+, index.zh-CN.md:58). The in-group overlap is a fixed -8px (antd groupOverlapping = -marginXS, style/index.ts:220) and does not scale with size.

note.zh: 本条目仅用 div + CSS(calc、border-radius、负 margin),全浏览器基线能力,无特性开关要适配;若改用真实图片,补 srcSet 与 loading 优化属增强而非兼容。
note.en: This entry uses only div + CSS (calc, border-radius, negative margins) — baseline capabilities in every browser, nothing to feature-detect. Real images would add srcSet and loading optimizations as enhancements, not compatibility work.

fallback.zh: 图片加载失败时的降级链与 antd 一致:icon > 子元素(字符);本 demo 直接用姓氏字符,即天然降级形态。字符头像务必保证底色与字符对比度 ≥ 4.5:1,否则回退到更深底色。
fallback.en: On image failure the fallback chain matches antd: icon > children (glyph); this demo uses surname glyphs directly, which is already the degraded form. Ensure glyph-on-fill contrast ≥ 4.5:1, otherwise fall back to a deeper fill.

use.zh: 会话/评论/成员列表中标识「谁在说话」——尺寸小(24-32px),靠相邻文字补充身份
use.en: Identifying 'who is speaking' in threads/comments/member lists — small (24–32px), identity carried by adjacent text

use.zh: 协作者组:文档/项目页顶部重叠排列 + 溢出 +N(antd Group max 语义)
use.en: Collaborator stacks: overlapping avatars with a +N overflow on doc/project pages (antd Group max semantics)

use.zh: 个人设置、账户切换等需要「人」的心理暗示的位置
use.en: Places that need the psychological cue of a person: profile settings, account switchers

avoid.zh: 把头像当装饰图标用——它会暗示一个真实的人;装饰位请用 icon
avoid.en: Using avatars as decorative icons — they imply a real person; use icons for decoration

avoid.zh: 小尺寸(<24px)硬塞字符或图片——字符不可读、图片不可辨
avoid.en: Cramming glyphs or photos below 24px — glyphs stop being readable and photos stop being recognizable

avoid.zh: 重叠组里塞大量头像却不折叠——超过 4-5 个必须折叠 +N,否则辨识度为零
avoid.en: Piling many avatars into an overlap without folding — past 4–5 they must fold into +N or identity is lost

a11y.zh: 头像必须可命名:配可见文字名,或 alt/aria-label 给出人名(纯装饰头像才允许 alt="");重叠组对外要表达完整名单——antd 用 popover 承载被折叠成员,demo 的 +N 徽标旁以 aria-label 声明总人数;方形圆角 6px 保留 3:1 边界对比(WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.11);字符头像底色与字符对比 ≥ 4.5:1(SC 1.4.3)。
a11y.en: Avatars must be nameable: pair with a visible name or give alt/aria-label the person's name (alt="" only for purely decorative ones); an overlap group must still expose the full roster — antd carries folded members in a popover, and this demo declares the total via aria-label next to the +N chip; the 6px square radius keeps a 3:1 boundary contrast (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.11); glyph avatars keep ≥ 4.5:1 fill-to-glyph contrast (SC 1.4.3).

goal.zh: 复刻一组重叠头像:8 人名单按 groupCount 实像展示、其余折叠为 +N 徽标;头像尺寸参数化(24-64px),圆/方两形,组内固定 -8px 重叠 + 白色描边。
goal.en: Replicate an overlapping avatar group: an 8-person roster shows the first groupCount members and folds the rest into a +N chip; avatar size parameterized (24–64px), circle/square shapes, fixed -8px overlap with white ring borders.

acceptance.zh: 头像尺寸严格用参数快照值驱动宽高与字号(字号 = 尺寸 × 0.4375)
acceptance.en: Avatar size drives both box and glyph size from the exact snapshot value (glyph = size × 0.4375)

acceptance.zh: circle 圆角 50%、square 圆角 6px,两者切换不改其他样式
acceptance.en: circle uses a 50% radius and square 6px; switching shapes changes nothing else

acceptance.zh: 组内重叠固定 -8px 负 margin,白色 2px 描边(groupBorderColor)
acceptance.en: In-group overlap is a fixed -8px negative margin with 2px white ring borders (groupBorderColor)

acceptance.zh: 溢出项折叠为一个 +N 徽标,N = 总数 - 展示数,徽标样式与头像同尺寸
acceptance.en: Overflow folds into one +N chip, N = total − shown, sized like the avatars

acceptance.zh: 每个头像可命名(可见文字名或 aria-label),组声明完整名单
acceptance.en: Every avatar is nameable (visible name or aria-label) and the group declares its full roster
